findings.text: follow-on: the done_when requires "ruff format --check and ruff check findings on every changed path do not exceed base" but the manifest records no ruff command or result (test_logs names only pytest logs); the delta is zero when measured (11 findings at both 2cbe964 and 825cb62e, 2 files already formatted), so the substance holds and only the record is missing.

follow-on: each negative-control log's revision header names base 2cbe964 while the mutation was applied to the fixed but then-uncommitted working tree, so the log's own header cannot show that the guard under test was the head revision's; only negctl.sh's assert ties the log to that guard.

item_verdicts.diff: read 825cb62e against base 2cbe964; three files, reckon/mcp.py +9/-3 (the reached flag and the guard that reads it), tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py +156/-9 (the crew driver and three cases), and the new evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's measure is the pytest run over the three named files with zero added failures and a per-case negative control, plus a ruff delta clause; after_gate.log records "1 failed, 12 passed in 301.47s" at head 825cb62e against baseline_gate.log's "1 failed, 9 passed in 113.40s" at base 2cbe964 (the same single pre-existing failure, test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window), and nc1/nc2/nc3 each redden their own case, but the ruff clause has no recorded result.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to add a case each in tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py for the crew tool returning a failing current-code answer with its stamp, a child that never reaches the tool, and a child that makes no answer, fixing reckon/mcp.py where a case exposes a defect; the landed change adds tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py:377,406,429 for the three cases and reckon/mcp.py:317,328,450 for the reached flag that the never-reached case exposes.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; status complete, commit 825cb62e, the tests line names the pytest command, baseline_suite and after_suite are one-line JSON with revision, command, exit_status, log_path, completed and failure_ids, and after_suite's revision 825cb62e equals after_gate.log's first line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/mcp.py, tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py, docs/evidence/fragments/every-plan-write-goes-through-edit-plan/epw-reload-branches-have-cases.html and the figures directory; git diff --stat 2cbe964 825cb62e touches only the first three, all inside them.

justifications.durability: nc2_never_reached_arm.log applies the mutation that deletes the reckon/mcp.py:450 guard and reddens tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py:414, so the case fails if the guard regresses; nc1 and nc3 control the other two cases.
justifications.evidence: after_gate.log's summary line "1 failed, 12 passed in 301.47s" at head 825cb62e differs from baseline_gate.log's "1 failed, 9 passed in 113.40s" by three gained cases and zero added failures, and the base-revision reproduction is recorded in head_before_fix2.log, but the done_when's ruff clause has no recorded result.
justifications.fit: reckon/mcp.py:326-327 follows the module's out[...] child-protocol idiom and comment style, and the added test and case names carry no plan, version or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp.py:317,328 add the reached flag the goal's "fixing reckon/mcp.py where a case exposes a defect" clause requires and tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py:377,406,429 adds the three named cases, so the landed change is the goal's deliverable.
justifications.reuse: the reached key extends the existing child protocol (reckon/mcp.py:317 params/answer) rather than forking it; a search over reckon/ for another did-the-child-reach-the-tool mechanism found none, reckon/mcp.py:415 inferring it only for the signature decision from empty params.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 2cbe964 825cb62e lists only reckon/mcp.py, tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py and the declared evidence fragment.
